title: IT- Sr Systems Engineer (Boomi)
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Job Title – Senior Boomi Integration Engineer**
**Position:** 
 Senior Boomi Integration Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Onsite (Noida)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 7\+ years
   

  

**Grade:** 
 IT3
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Boomi Integration Engineer to design, build, and support
 **secure, scalable, and productionready enterprise integrations** 
 using
 **Dell Boomi AtomSphere** 
 . This role is primarily focused on
 **Boomi development, APIled integrations, and production support** 
 , with strong
 **database development skills** 
 and
 **Java** 
 used as supporting capabilities to offload and centralize business logic where appropriate.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise integrations using Dell Boomi AtomSphere
* Build and manage Boomi processes, APIs, connectors, listeners, and reusable components
* Configure and manage Atoms, Molecules, Atom Clouds, and environments across Dev / Test / Prod
* Implement API management including policies, throttling, rate limiting, and versioning
* Develop integrations using REST, SOAP, HTTP/S, FTP/SFTP, file\-based, and event\-driven patterns
* Implement robust error handling, alerting, retries, reprocessing, and exception frameworks
* Support Boomi Atom Queues and asynchronous integration patterns
* Work with XML, JSON, CSV, EDI (X12 / EDIFACT) and database\-based integrations
* Perform Boomi platform governance, deployment management, and connector license administration
* Provide L2/L3 production support, monitoring integrations and meeting SLA/SLO requirements
* Document integration flows, data mappings, dependencies, and operational runbooks


**Java \& Supporting Skills**
* Working knowledge of Java 17, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and Webservices using Java and webserver like Tomcat
* Develop custom Java or Groovy scripts within Boomi for complex transformations
* Experience writing core Java Batch programs for bulk and scheduled processing


**Database Development \& Data Processing**
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle and PostgreSQL databases
* Write and optimize complex SQL queries to support integration and reporting
* Design and develop stored procedures, functions, and packages to implement business logic at the database layer
* Leverage PL/SQL (or equivalent procedural SQL) to handle Data Validation \& Transformations, Aggregations and Calculations, High Volume data processing and batch operations
* Tune queries, indexes, and execution plans for performance and scalability
* Collaborate with application and integration layers to push logic down to the database where appropriate
* Troubleshoot datarelated production issues such as locking, performance degradation, and data inconsistencies


**Security \& Production Readiness (Must Have)**
* Strong fundamentals of security protocols, including: SFTP, HTTPS, Encryption (PGP, AES) protocols
* Hands\-on experience in Key Managements, rotation, expiration handling
* Experience managing SSL/TLS certificates like Installation, renewal, trust chains, keystores, and handshake errors
* Wellversed in common production issues, like Expired/Mismatched Certs, Invalid PGP Keys / Pass phrases, TLS/Cipher incompatibilities, Authentication \& Authorization failures, network, firewall, proxy and connectivity issues:
* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, compliance, and audit standards


**Preferred / Huge Plus**
* Experience building and deploying Agentic AI modules using Boomi AI Agent Builder
* Focus on custom agent design and deployment, not autogenerated integrations
* Experience building agent workflows outside of Boomi and integrating them into Boomi is also a strong plus


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years of hands\-on Dell Boomi experience in enterprise environments
* Strong background in integration patterns, APIled connectivity, and production support
* Proven experience supporting missioncritical integrations with strict SLAs
* Strong database development experience (SQL, stored procedures, performance tuning)
* Boomi Certifications (Integration Professional, Solution Design Specialist)
* Experience with Salesforce, Coupa, SAP(ECC), S4/Hana, SharePoint, Office 365, and B2B/EDI integrations


**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Staff Systems Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**Staff Systems Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure (OpenStack \& OpenShift)**
**Position:** 
 Staff Systems Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure
   

  

**Grade:** 
 IT4
   

  

**Location:** 
 Noida / Bangalore
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a
 **Staff Systems Engineer – Cloud Infrastructure** 
 to design, implement, and manage large\-scale public, private, and hybrid cloud platforms, with deep expertise in
 **OpenStack, OpenShift, and cloud IaaS/container technologies** 
 . This role serves as a technical authority and architect for cloud infrastructure platforms that power mission\-critical workloads across EDA, Systems design, AI/ML, and high\-performance computing environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings hands\-on engineering depth, strong systems thinking, and a proven track record of leading complex cloud platform initiatives—from architecture through production operations—while mentoring senior engineers and influencing platform strategy across the organization. Experience with
 **container platforms (OpenShift/Kubernetes)** 
 and the emerging
 **Red Hat OpenStack Services on OpenShift (RHOSO)** 
 model is a strong advantage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Cloud Platform Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Define and implement reference architectures for private cloud (OpenStack), container platforms (OpenShift), and hybrid/multi\-cloud environments.
* Contribute towards architectural decisions for compute, storage, networking, and control plane services at scale.
* Ensure platform consistency, scalability, resiliency, and operational excellence across regions and data centers.
* Evaluate and guide adoption of emerging cloud, container, and IaaS technologies aligned with business and platform strategy.


**Private Cloud \& OpenStack Leadership**
* Serve as a technical expert for OpenStack (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone, Glance, Heat, Octavia, etc.).
* Monitor, maintain, and optimize OpenStack deployments for performance, availability, upgradeability, and lifecycle management.
* Lead complex upgrades, migrations, and capacity expansions with minimal customer impact.
* Define best practices for multi\-tenant isolation, quota management, and SLA\-driven design.


**Container Platform \& OpenShift Engineering**
* Design, deploy, and operate OpenShift/Kubernetes clusters supporting containerized and cloud\-native workloads.
* Manage cluster lifecycle including provisioning, scaling, upgrades, and patching.
* Implement best practices for container networking, storage integration, RBAC, and workload isolation.
* Integrate OpenShift platforms with underlying OpenStack and bare\-metal infrastructure.
* Contribute to adoption and operations of RHOSO (Red Hat OpenStack Services on OpenShift), where the OpenStack control plane runs on OpenShift.


**Public Cloud \& Hybrid Cloud Integration**
* Design and integrate workloads across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP alongside private cloud platforms.
* Establish patterns for hybrid networking, identity federation, and workload portability.
* Provide technical guidance on cloud\-native and IaaS\-based workload placement decisions.


**Infrastructure Engineering \& Automation**
* Develop infrastructure\-as\-code and automation using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Promote platform standardization, self\-service provisioning, and repeatable operational workflows.
* Perform SRE and operations activities to improve observability, reliability, and incident response.


**Performance, Scale \& Reliability**
* Perform root cause analysis for complex platform issues across compute, network, storage, and container layers.
* Optimize cloud and container platforms for high\-performance workloads, including AI/ML, batch, and HPC\-style systems.
* Monitor and improve key reliability, performance, and capacity metrics.


**Technical Leadership \& Collaboration**
* Act as a senior technical authority across cloud and infrastructure teams.
* Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across the organization.
* Influence roadmap priorities through deep technical insight and clear communication with engineering and technical leaders.
* Partner closely with security, networking, hardware, and application teams to deliver integrated solutions.


**Experience**
**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or large\-scale platform engineering.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with OpenStack in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating OpenShift / Kubernetes clusters in production.
* Proven experience designing and operating large\-scale private and hybrid cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated leadership on complex, cross\-team infrastructure initiatives.


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Strong knowledge of:
+ OpenStack services (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone, etc.)
+ OpenShift/Kubernetes container orchestration and cluster operations
+ Linux systems and virtualization (KVM)
+ Software\-defined networking (SDN), L2/L3 networking, load balancing
+ Distributed storage systems (Ceph, object/block storage)

* Experience with:
+ Public cloud IaaS (AWS, Azure, GCP)
+ Infrastructure automation and IaC
+ CI/CD pipelines supporting platform engineering


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with RHOSO (Red Hat OpenStack Services on OpenShift) or the OpenStack\-on\-OpenShift control plane model.
* Red Hat certifications (RHCE, Red Hat Certified OpenStack Administrator, or Red Hat Certified OpenShift Administrator).
* Experience supporting HPC/EDA workloads on cloud platforms.
* Exposure to bare\-metal provisioning, hardware lifecycle management, and data center operations.
* Familiarity with SRE practices, reliability engineering, and large\-scale observability platforms.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence at senior and executive levels.


**Educational Qualification**
* BE/BTech/ME/MTech in CS/Electronics or equivalent.


**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: IT - Sr Systems Engineer (SFDC Business Systems Analyst)
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
**IT –Business Systems Analyst**
**Location** 
 : Noida, India
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full Time
   

  

**About The Role**
 Cadence IT is seeking a Business Systems Analyst with strong experience supporting sales and customer support workflows across Salesforce‑based ecosystems, along with hands‑on experience using AI‑assisted delivery techniques (e.g., vibe coding, agentic AI). Success in this role requires the ability to operate across business, data, and automation layers—bringing clarity, speed, and measurable outcomes to complex customer support workflows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Partner with business stakeholders to optimize sales, support and customer community workflows, enabling self‑service, streamlining handoffs, and reducing manual effort across support channels.
* Leverage AI\-assisted delivery techniques (including ‘vibe coding’/rapid prototyping) to validate concepts quickly with users and accelerate iteration.
* Design and leverage AI agents and workflow orchestration capabilities to automate complex end\-to\-end business processes with built\-in governance, exception handling, security/access controls, and operational oversight.
* Establish success metrics to measure cycle time reduction, elimination of handoffs, user adoption, and process compliance.
* Assess upstream/downstream impacts across integrated systems, document system interactions, data dependencies, and exception paths.
* Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria—including agent\-ready rules and guardrails.
* Drive UAT readiness, including test planning, end\-to\-end validation, and stakeholder coordination to ensure solutions meet business expectations.
* Collaborate with Development, QA, InfoSec, and Enterprise Architecture to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned to enterprise standards.


**What You Bring**
**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years of Business Systems Analyst experience supporting large‑scale enterprise applications in a global environment.
* 3\+ years deep experience with Salesforce application ecosystems, with a strong focus on Sales, Service Cloud \& Experience Cloud (Community Cloud).
* Demonstrated expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud, including opportunity and pipeline management, lead\-to\-cash processes, forecasting and CPQ integration, and data governance—enabling accurate revenue visibility, scalable sales operations, and AI\-driven insights across the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle.
* Hands\-on experience with Service Cloud and Experience Cloud, including case management, knowledge base, omni\-channel routing, self\-service, and customer data quality—enabling end\-to\-end service automation and AI\-driven workflows.
* Proven ability to use rapid prototyping or AI\-assisted development techniques (e.g., Vibe Coding, low code/no code, or similar approaches) to accelerate solution validation and delivery.
* Experience working in Agile and iterative delivery environments, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, incremental releases, and rapid feedback loops.
* Experience designing and leveraging AI agents and workflow orchestration to automate end‑to‑end business processes.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to a variety of audiences.
* Comfortable collaborating with business stakeholders to navigate ambiguity, align priorities, and drive outcomes in fast‑moving environments.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Software Engineering or a related field.
* Salesforce certifications (Salesforce Certified Application Architect, Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Community Cloud), demonstrating strong platform and data model fluency.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience working in complex, global, and highly integrated enterprise environments.
* Experience in the high\-tech or semiconductor industry, supporting complex, global and highly integrated business processes.


**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
